claim: Origin: a child in a mid-August 2026 YouTube gaming video says he 'can't do nothing', heard as 'can't do Nathan'; spread on TikTok and Instagram from late August into September
excerpt: The video was uploaded to YouTube in mid-August 2026, and the audio of the kid saying he "can't do Nathan" was popularized on sites including TikTok and Instagram later in August and through early September 2026
title: I Can't Do Nathan
